notes.title: Update 1.02
notes.content:
Changes:

- Add Invert Controls Option
- Swap Levels 1-1 and 1-3 in the hopes of making it easier to start playing
- Tune the camera zooming behaviour, hopefully for the better
- A few enhancements to the GUI for the tutorial
